name: CGame function map
notes: Offsets are RAM addresses from main_DDRII.dol unless stated otherwise.
This file tracks CGame factory/setup functions separately from CSelect and generic resource managers.

key_fields.meaning: next/active module state; set to 5 on error and 2 when setup completes
setup mode; -1 takes direct player-data setup path
player-data-derived setup fields copied before subsystem +0x3F0 is configured
optional owned object/resource pointer; released during substate 0 reset

substates.meaning: reset managers/subsystems and choose setup path
notes: If cgame +0x0B8 == -1, copies player data into cgame setup fields and moves to substate 3.
Otherwise starts gBootTempManager loading through BootResourceBundle_StartLoading and moves to substate 1.
When FUN_8002202C(gBootTempManager) returns nonzero, calls BootResourceBundle_ApplyLoadedResources(gBootTempManager) and moves to substate 2.
If result is 1, configures subsystem +0x3F0 and moves to substate 3.

substates.meaning: wait for resource managers and wire CGame subsystem outputs
notes: Waits for archive/resource manager and gManager_802E70A4 readiness.
Uses subsystem +0x3F0 output handles to configure +0x428, +0x40C, +0x3FC, and +0x404.
Moves to substate 0x0C when the field is zero.

called_helpers_pending_export.role: CGame readiness/check function used in substate 2
